subject.title: feat: unify external sessions with native catalog pagination

question: Should external plugin-owned session catalogs become a permanent generic Gateway and Plugin SDK surface that appears in native session UX whenever the owning plugin is active?
rationale: Fixing the bounded-page defect does not decide whether OpenClaw should permanently own the new public plugin contract, retire provider-specific surfaces, or make the Codex operator catalog visible independently of the supervision opt-in.

options.title: Adopt the generic contract
options.body: Keep the new API and default catalog registration after fixing pagination and proving compatibility, upgrade, and real behavior.

options.title: Narrow the rollout
options.body: Keep corrected native UI pagination while deferring the public SDK and default-visibility changes to a separate decision.

options.title: Retain provider-owned catalogs
options.body: Keep the existing provider-specific surfaces until maintainers approve a narrower generic contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the new API and default catalog registration after fixing pagination and proving compatibility, upgrade, and real behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged feature history and linked issue identify this person as the current design owner across both provider catalogs and their proposed unification.
